title: Host-wide content-addressed store / Rechnerweiter inhaltsadressierter Speicher
$comment: 🗄️ CasPolicyV1: one store per host, shared and deduplicated by all workspaces, size-capped with least-recently-accessed eviction. Byte sizes are plain numbers; ratios are fractions of capBytes.

GraphClosureArea.$comment: The host collector accounts for source inventories. The graph owner retires them under its reference census and writer cut.

Budget.$comment: EN: The disk budget of the partition that holds the store, derived from the partition size instead of fixed shares: a command may start while its need plus the cushion is free, a collection starts while its need plus the reserve is not free, and a collection goes on until the hysteresis more is free. The reserve is the largest declared need of any stage times the safety factor of the workspace scale family, so no disk stranded by a fixed percentage. A partition below minimumTotalFactor times reserve plus hysteresis keeps the fixed shares of Policy.partition. DE: Das Plattenbudget der Partition des Speichers, aus der Partitionsgröße abgeleitet statt aus festen Anteilen: ein Befehl darf starten, solange sein Bedarf plus Puffer frei ist, eine Sammlung startet, solange sein Bedarf plus Reserve nicht frei ist, und läuft weiter, bis die Hysterese mehr frei ist. Die Reserve ist der größte deklarierte Bedarf einer Stufe mal Sicherheitsfaktor der Familie der Arbeitsbereichsgröße, damit keine Platte durch einen festen Prozentsatz gestrandet wird. Eine Partition unter minimumTotalFactor mal Reserve plus Hysterese behält die festen Anteile von Policy.partition.

Holder.$comment: A registered reference holder of the host store: a cache root outside the store (a unit cache of any checkout, a proof or test root) whose entry files name store objects. The collector protects the objects its live entries reference and, only when the cap still needs bytes after every unreferenced object is gone, evicts the least recently used entries together with the objects nothing else references. A holder that is not renewed for holderTtlMs, or whose root vanished, ages out.

places.reason: The bun content cache never changes a stored file in place.
Pinned tool archives are written once under their digest.
The Bazel disk cache CAS names every file by its digest and replaces, never edits, it.
Installed trees can be patched or rewritten by their tools, so only copy-on-write clones are safe.
Installed toolchains can be updated in place by their tools, so only copy-on-write clones are safe.
